boundary.reason: Workflow execution stays inside the local repo contract unless the approval gate explicitly authorizes something stronger.

task.stop_condition: Workflow command finished and a run log was written.
non_goals: Do not treat this routine workflow log as retained proof by itself.

required_context.name: package README or donor leaf README
latest stop-gate or replacement-review finding from the capped essay
latest ceiling report or legacy donor-report pair from the capped essay
current overlay artifacts when they already exist
package evidence surface when local papers already anchor the failed object
current package shape, including whether umbrella upgrade or leaf initialization is still pending

expected_outputs: umbrella upgrade when starting from a single-publication donor
donor leaf plus successor flagship leaf when a second object becomes real
pivot slate with ranked candidate families
north-star viability gate for any candidate being considered for clearance

expected_outputs.explicit pivot decision: blocked, provisional, clear lead, or pivot cleared

checks.name: command_exit_status
checks.notes: Workflow command or launch-pack emission result.

verification.residual_risk: This is a bounded workflow run log. Preserve a stronger proof packet separately if the run becomes decision-critical.

possible_failures: A guided workflow was mistaken for hidden execution.
A local workflow log was mistaken for approval to mutate an external system.
